text: Good afternoon, a person fell off a bicycle in the park and injured their arm. They are conscious but in severe pain.
I need help, there is a lot of smoke coming from an apartment kitchen and the neighbors are evacuating the building.
An elderly man feels very dizzy and cannot stay on his feet. He is awake but says he feels very weak.
There was a collision between two vehicles at an intersection. One person has a wound on their forehead and needs medical attention.
My neighbor cut their hand while working with a tool. The wound is bleeding heavily and we cannot get it to stop.
A fallen tree is completely blocking an avenue after a storm. I do not see anyone injured, but vehicles cannot pass.
A child is having difficulty breathing after running at school. She is conscious, but breathing very quickly and says she cannot get enough air.
A fire alarm is sounding and there is a burning smell inside a store. People are leaving the building.
A person fainted at a bus stop. They are awake again, but they seem confused and do not remember what happened.
A motorcyclist fell on the road. They have scrapes on their legs and say their shoulder hurts badly.
There is a major water leak inside a house and the water is getting close to several electrical outlets.
My teammate received a strong blow to the head during a game. He is conscious but has nausea and a severe headache.
A car stopped in the middle of a tunnel and smoke started coming from the engine. The occupants have already left the vehicle.
A pregnant woman is having frequent contractions and needs transportation to a medical center.
A person is trapped inside an elevator that stopped working. They can communicate with us and do not appear to be injured.
A worker fell from a short ladder. He can speak, but says he has severe back pain and does not want to move.
A dog bit a person on the street. The wound is on the leg and there is moderate bleeding.
Electrical cables have fallen onto the sidewalk after strong winds. Nobody has touched them and we are keeping our distance.
A person is having an allergic reaction after eating. Their face is swelling and they say they are having trouble breathing.
There was a minor collision between a bus and a car. Passengers are getting out and one person reports neck pain.
